finding.root_cause: The combined wrapper loaded the parent runner with runpy.run_path and submitted the parent's private _DevelopmentTask instance directly to ProcessPoolExecutor. That record therefore carried the synthetic module name <run_path>, which a spawned worker cannot import while unpickling the submitted call.
finding.scientific_impact: none: task serialization failed before input materialization, candidate execution, coarse-control execution, Dask comparison, aggregation, or atomic publication

recommended_repair.execution_boundary: convert each parent task to a built-in mapping of JSON-compatible cell, dataset, recipe, and input identity before submission; reconstruct the validated records inside the worker before calling the unchanged serial task path
required_tests: the submitted payload contains no run-path-only class and survives a pickle round trip
the reconstructed cell, dataset, recipe, and input identity equal the parent task exactly
malformed payloads fail closed before science execution
the complete no-write preflight binds the repaired wrapper, tests, candidate, population, runtime, paths, and absent output

required_next_decision: after test-first repair and a complete no-write preflight, freeze a new non-executable process-repair identity and obtain a new exact one-use execution approval before any retry
